title: SDE job-posting investigation: Google, Microsoft, Amazon
description: Interview focus block: study real role descriptions and extract the skills employers actually ask for.
detail:
Estimated duration: 2 hr 15 min

Links:
- https://www.google.com/about/careers/applications/jobs/results/
- https://jobs.careers.microsoft.com/global/en/search
- https://www.amazon.jobs/en/search?base_query=software%20development%20engineer
- https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/
- https://www.workbc.ca/
- https://www.surrey.ca/about-surrey/jobs-careers
- https://jobs.vancouver.ca/
- https://www.burnaby.ca/our-city/get-involved/jobs-and-careers
- https://www.idealist.org/en/jobs
- https://www.idealist.org/en/volunteer

Steps:
1. Open the Google, Microsoft, and Amazon job boards and collect one software engineer or SDE posting that is close to your target.
2. For each posting, note required skills, preferred skills, years of experience, and communication signals.
3. Build a 3-column comparison table.
4. Highlight the top 10 repeated keywords across the postings.
5. Mark each keyword as: strong evidence, weak evidence, or missing from your current profile.
6. Start a local opportunity tracker: save at least 1 full-time role from LinkedIn, 1 BC or nearby-city role from WorkBC, Surrey, Vancouver, or Burnaby, and 1 part-time or volunteer opportunity from Idealist.
7. Finish with a 5-line plan for what to strengthen first based on both the SDE postings and the local job search.
